(Search snippet content — full article returned no text on direct fetch; The Times of Israel's own reporting language)

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has fired the Pentagon's top military planner Gen. Brett Sylvia, who served as head of strategy, plans and policy on the Joint Chiefs of Staff. He is the second general to be ousted from the post, known in military circles as the "J5," under Hegseth.
There is no immediate replacement for Sylvia and no reason has been given for the firing.
US officials have told several Middle East countries and regional allies to be prepared for potential renewed military action after Tuesday's elections as well as for the possibility that Iran will attempt to retaliate against them. However, Trump has not made a final decision on new strikes.
